propositions: Prior plan-review findings recalled without persisted evidence are re-injected with empty evidence list, causing pass-2 verification to rubber-stamp bare assertions instead of re-grounding against current plan text

The recall mechanism acts as a permanent ratchet: recalled findings are re-verified as block and re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings, re-qualifying them for recall on every subsequent review round

Prior findings are recalled regardless of whether the underlying plan material has changed, so fresh finder's silence on edited material is misinterpreted as a miss rather than evidence the issue was resolved
Pass-2 backstop does not fire because absence veto logic receives no grounding: evidence_entails_finding has no quotes to test against the current plan and verifier confirms bare restatements
Recalled candidates must carry original persisted evidence and impact into injection so pass-2 can judge original quotes against current plan material
Prior findings with no persisted evidence must be ineligible for recall to break the ratchet, and material fingerprint must gate recall eligibility so changed material suppresses replay
